notes:
Fiji COVID 19 tests line list
This report generates a list of all patients that have received a COVID-19 test. Each row represents a lab request and includes patient, 'COVID-19 Sample Collection' survey and lab request information. Patients are listed in chroological order by requested date. 

Lab requests with a status of Cancelled, Deleted or Entered in error are excluded from this report.
